rules: One BRAIN/CNS reality spine; no parallel truth stores.
Missing evidence is UNKNOWN/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never zero or proven harm.
Source fact, source claim, inference, estimate, interpretation and recommendation remain distinguishable.
Conflicts fail closed; newest-wins is forbidden.
No precision upgrade beyond source support.
Self-reported company/product claims remain self-reported until corroborated.
Sponsor/payment can never buy evidence, rank or recommendation.
Learning is bounded: propose → test → compare → keep/reject → preserve → rollback.
Sensitive Nature locations must be generalized or restricted.
Explicit Founder cutover is required before CNS becomes authoritative.
